reviewType: Independent editorial and visual quality review

scope.themes: Color contact frames for editorial correspondence. Existing all-theme technical QA is referenced but not re-performed or treated as editorial proof.
scope.playback: No audible playback, live browser or external network used. Static scene frames plus targeted authored motion-code inspection; not continuous-motion or performance-listening validation.
scope.mutations: Review artifact only; films, scripts, audio, manifests and shared runtime not edited.

summary.scriptFinding: All films name the book early and generally preserve genre, source qualification, continuity and a specific starting point. Hunger and Cascade would benefit from a more concrete reading promise.
summary.visualFinding: The main weakness is semantic illustration, not typography or delivery existence. Near-identical first/second compositions and returns in scene four flatten many films; several source-specific situations are replaced by abstract shapes that do not make the narrated consequence visible.

crossBatchFindings.finding: Make the specific narrated cause and consequence visible in the seven revision-required films; moving an unrelated symbol does not satisfy this.
Reduce repeated introductory copy and near-identical first/second tableaux. Continuity motifs are valid when viewpoint, action or consequence changes materially.

The scene emotional plans repeat attention → concern → reflection → curiosity and generic gestures across the batch. Replace these with beat-specific actions and motivated changes of gaze/posture, especially in intimate fiction.

Frequent phrases about the book, its distinctive approach, authority and consequences keep purpose clear but homogenize the literary voice. Replace only expendable meta phrasing with one concrete example, preserving the book-introduction purpose.

evidence.text: The Voluptuous Apocalypse examines the relief that can hide inside fantasies of catastrophe.
